titles.romaji: Gogo no Kouchou: Junai Mellow yori
titles.english: The Neglected Nympho & the Soccer Stud
titles.native: 午後の紅潮 ~純愛メロウより~

description:
Yayoi is a housewife who is sexually frustrated with her husband for not giving her time to have sex because she is busy working, but lately her husband has not paid attention to Yayoi. Yayoi started to fantasize a lot. An accidental encounter with a nice young man from the neighborhood who has a crush on Yayoi.

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated and Edited)
